access.mineEmpty: You have no open access right now.

backfill.title: Offer run for slot
backfill.note: Nothing is sent to a patient from here. Send holds the slot for the current candidate and records the offer; you deliver it yourself from the Offers tab.
backfill.prepareBody: Starts the run for this slot: the waitlist is ranked by clinical priority and the run stops at the first candidate for you to decide. Nothing is sent to anyone.
backfill.started: The run is started. Decide what to do with the first candidate.
backfill.noRun: There is no offer run for this slot yet.
backfill.notConfigured: Offer runs are not set up yet. Nothing was started or changed.

waiting.send_decision: Your decision to send, skip or stop
waiting.reply_entry: The patient's reply to be entered

backfill.noWaiting: Nobody on the waitlist matches this slot.

send.title: Send the offer to this candidate?
send.body: Holds the slot for the current candidate and records the offer. The system sends nothing to the patient: you deliver the offer yourself from the Offers tab.

skip.title: Skip this candidate?
skip.body: Passes over the current candidate and moves to the next one on the waitlist. Nothing is sent.

stop.title: Stop the run?
stop.body: Ends the run for this slot. No offer is made and nobody else is considered.

decided.send: The offer was recorded for the candidate. Finished: {{finished}}.

backfill.notWaitingForThis: The run is not waiting for that. Refresh and look again.

reply.title: The patient's reply
reply.none: No stored reply was found for this patient. The reply has to be stored first; this console cannot store one yet. If none came, choose No reply came.
reply.pick: Stored messages from this patient's appointments thread
reply.notConfigured: Reply reading is not set up yet. Read the message yourself.
reply.erased: That message was erased and cannot be read.
reply.noSuggestion: No suggestion: a person must read the reply.

reasons.red_flag: The rules found a red flag
reasons.unassessable: The rules could not assess it
reasons.not_a_patient_reply: It is not a patient's reply

reply.screenedNote: The rules did not clear this reply. Entering it raises the nurse task and ends the run.
reply.yourCall: Entering the reply records it as stored. What it means is your decision.
reply.enterBody: Records the stored message you picked as the patient's reply. The red-flag rules screen it first; a red flag or a reply they cannot assess raises the nurse task and ends the run.
reply.noReplyBody: Records that the patient did not reply in time. The run moves on.
reply.notWaiting: The run is not waiting for a reply. Refresh and look again.
